parole.testo: From Proto-Slavic *pogača, from Medieval Latin focacea, focacia, a derivative of focus (“hearth, fireplace”), in the meaning "hearth bread" (panis focācius). Cognate with Italian focaccia (“a type of flat bread with toppings”).
